name: Jellyfin Media Server
description: Stream your movies, shows and music to any device. Supports Intel Quick Sync hardware transcoding through /dev/dri passthrough.

name: Docker & Portainer CE
description: Docker Engine in a nested unprivileged container, managed through the Portainer CE web UI.

name: Portainer CE
description: Optional web UI for containers. Docker Engine & Compose are built in (Compute > Docker); each Portainer CE instance runs in its own lightweight container with an isolated Docker environment and can add more environments, such as the built-in engine through the Portainer Agent.

name: Samba File Server
description: Lightweight standalone SMB server. Creates a read-only guest share 'public' and, when storage is mounted, a 'storage' share for Samba users.

name: AdGuard Home
description: Network-wide DNS ad and tracker blocker. Point your router's DNS at this container after setup.

name: Nginx Proxy Manager
description: Reverse proxy with free Let's Encrypt SSL certificates and a friendly web UI (default login admin@example.com / changeme).

name: Immich
description: Self-hosted photo and video backup with mobile apps, face recognition and smart search.

name: Local AI Studio (Ollama + Open WebUI)
description: Private ChatGPT-style AI on your own hardware: Ollama with NVIDIA CUDA (RTX GPUs), Intel/AMD Vulkan or CPU, an optional Open WebUI chat on port 3000, and a model library with VRAM fit ratings in the Local AI app.

name: SolarDeck Edge Proxy
description: Hardened reverse proxy container managed by Settings > Reverse Proxy & SSL.

name: SolarDeck Backup Worker
description: Isolated offsite backup worker managed by Settings > Backups & Disaster Recovery.

name: SolarDeck Docker Engine
description: Isolated Docker Engine & Compose runtime managed by Compute > Docker.
